title: Responder Assist CLI and incident-blueprint autodocumenter
author: Ava Martinez
release_notes: Introduces a CLI to assist on-call responders with context-aware playbooks and an autodocumenter that generates incident blueprints and sanitized telemetry bundles for post-incident reviews.
description:
Context and motivation: On-call responders frequently spend the first 10–20 minutes assembling context (service owners, recent deploys, noisy alerts, probable mitigations) and then creating a post-incident artifact. This PR adds a lightweight Responder Assist CLI that fetches prioritized context, proposes immediate mitigation steps, and generates an 'incident blueprint' markdown doc automatically sanitized for sharing. The autodocumenter bundles a compact telemetry export and a top-level action timeline to speed RCA and reduce manual note-taking.

Checklist:
- [x] CLI: responder-assist (interactive and headless modes)
- [x] Autodocumenter: incident-blueprint generator with redaction rules
- [x] Telemetry minimizer: selective trace/log sampling + schema whitelist
- [x] Tests: unit + integration against staging telemetry
- [x] Docs: CLI quickstart and troubleshooting
- [x] E2E smoke in canary environment

Potential risks and mitigations:
- Risk: over-redaction removing important context. Mitigation: added tenant whitelist override and explicit testcases.
- Risk: generated docs become the canonical RCA without human review. Mitigation: docs include clear reminder and the CLI prompts for confirmation before publishing.

Backcompat: CLI is additive; no breaking changes.
